verdict.rationale: Skills equip Claude with document/data-handling capabilities (e.g., the xlsx skill for spreadsheet analysis, PDF extraction/form-filling) that can be used to derive insights from a user's own files, and community feedback confirms the xlsx skill 'nails many edge cases' in Excel data work. However, Skills is fundamentally an extensibility/packaging mechanism rather than a built-in insights/suggestions engine, and there's no evidence of proactive, in-product insight generation as a standalone feature — it depends on the user or Claude invoking the right skill, which community reports say is inconsistent ('hit or miss if it picks up on the skill'). Missing for 10: dedicated evidence of an insights/suggestions UI or proactive analytics feature, and first-party documentation framing Skills as an insight-generation tool rather than a generic capability-extension framework.
